name: Standard Data & Privacy Capabilities (v1)
description: Standard semantics for AI-agent access to datasets with privacy-relevant classification: which read/export/join/train/delete capabilities are authorized, scoped by dataset/column allowlists, row upper bounds (scalar number UPPER BOUNDS per CLC-v1 §6.2 (v1.1)) and purpose/region classification (allowed-set ARRAYS). Scheme-scoped constraint types declared by this scheme: data:purpose:<v> (purpose limitation), data:region:<v> (data residency/cross-border). Per CLC-v1 §8, unknown constraint types fail closed with deny("unknown_constraint").
author: varwof (open ecosystem)
note: IMPORTANT: This authorization layer defines the OPERATION BOUNDARY for an AI agent accessing data. It is NOT a privacy compliance certification: purpose limitation, retention, consent and cross-border transfer obligations remain with the data controller. Classification parameters (purpose/region) reduce but do not remove compliance duties.

capabilities.description: Read rows from an allowlisted dataset
capabilities.summary: Query a dataset within column allowlist, row bound, and purpose/region scope
capabilities.usage: Analytical reads with declared purpose and allowed regions
capabilities.when_not: Must not grant without a bounded scope; dataset/columns/purpose/region should be constrained

capabilities.summary: Materialize a bounded, scoped export of a dataset
capabilities.usage: Deliverables; data sharing with declared purpose
capabilities.when_not: Never grant without purpose and region declaration; row bound required

capabilities.summary: Combine datasets whose allowlists overlap the join scope
capabilities.usage: Cross-dataset analytics for a declared purpose
capabilities.when_not: Joins multiply exposure: only grant when the join column set is explicit

capabilities.description: Train a model on an allowlisted dataset
capabilities.summary: Use allowed datasets for model training runs with declared purpose
capabilities.usage: ML training; purpose must be training/research
capabilities.when_not: Never grant on production personal data without explicit erasure/purpose controls

capabilities.description: Delete a data subject's records from an allowlisted dataset
capabilities.summary: Erasure request execution scoped to a dataset and declared purpose
capabilities.when_not: Irreversible: must require audit and normally a separate erasure approval
